hints.title: Farthest Reach Table
hints.text: For each starting point up to target time, determine the farthest endpoint reachable by any clip that starts at or before that moment.

hints.title: Greedy Interval Extension
hints.text: This mirrors the Jump Game II pattern. Track the current covered horizon and the maximum horizon reachable with one additional clip.

hints.title: Stuck Detection
hints.text: Iterate second by second up to time. Expand the next horizon. When reaching the current horizon boundary, increment clip count. If current horizon fails to advance past the current second, return -1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively exploring all combinations of overlapping clips has exponential time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Aggregating maximum reach per starting index and sweeping up to T takes O(N + T) time and O(T) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize equivalence to Jump Game II or interval scheduling greedy paradigm.
complexity.notes: If initial clips cannot cover time 0, immediately returns -1.
